Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Dolma: an Open Corpus of Three Trillion Tokens for Language Model Pretraining Research (2402.00159v1) · paper method: The paper introduces Dolma as approximately 3T tokens across 5B documents from seven public data sources, alongside an open-source curation toolkit; its design primarily targets English text.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Dolma: an Open Corpus of Three Trillion Tokens for Language Model Pretraining Research (2402.00159v1) · paper method: Dolma’s general deduplication is within each source subset rather than across sources; its web pipeline uses URL, exact-document and exact-paragraph Bloom-filter stages, while code starts from The Stack’s prior near-deduplicated version.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Dolma: an Open Corpus of Three Trillion Tokens for Language Model Pretraining Research (2402.00159v1) · paper method: The paper’s Olmo-1b comparison is trained on roughly 3T tokens from preliminary Dolma v1.5; the table explicitly notes unequal training-token budgets for some comparator models and unknown StableLM2 data composition.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Dolma: an Open Corpus of Three Trillion Tokens for Language Model Pretraining Research (2402.00159v1) · paper method: The web pipeline uses regular-expression PII detection for email addresses, IP addresses and phone numbers; its 1B-model ablation reports no discernible performance difference from the studied masking/removal strategies.
